# Paper 9: DDPM (2020)

*Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models* · Module 3 — Reinforcement learning and generative modeling · [Track on the site](https://arubad.github.io/AI_Research_Journey/#paper-9)

- ▶ [Stanford CS236: Score & Diffusion](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VsllsC2JMGY)
- ▶ [Umar Jamil DDPM Code & Math](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I1sPXkm2NH4)

## Study approach
Derive the closed-form forward jump $x_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\,x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\,\epsilon$. Section 3.2: why predicting $\epsilon$ with MSE equals the ELBO and score matching.

## Break-it experiments
1. **HAND→AGENT** — Tiny DDPM on MNIST; switch the U-Net target from $\epsilon$ to $x_0$ and see blurry samples (Table 2).
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_tiny_ddpm_on_mnist_switch_the_u.ipynb`
2. **HAND→AGENT** — Set the Langevin noise $z = 0$ at every reverse step and watch deterministic sampling fail under the DDPM formulation.
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_set_the_langevin_noise_at_every.ipynb`
